title: WIP: Improve cost of container commit
body:
WIP: Only unit-tested, and I didn’t measure the impact at all.

- Avoid a wholly redundant `os.Lstat` in `TarWithOptions`
- Only look up parent directory of a file once per file

in `Root*Xattr*`, we still do `root.Open(".")` syscall N+2 times (where N is ~the number of xattrs). That could be further improved but it would ~require a Linux specific code variant :/

Might help with https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29833
